title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Responding to Lawsuits in Administrative Litigation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Several Issues Concerning Administrative Litigation Response

Fa [2016] No. 260

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Central Leading Group for Comprehensively Deepening Reform, on October 13, 2015, deliberated and adopted the Opinions on Strengthening and Improving Administrative Litigation Response (hereinafter referred to as the Opinions), which explicitly require administrative organs to support the people's courts in accepting and hearing administrative cases, guarantee the right of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations to institute proceedings, conscientiously perform the work of submitting pleadings and evidence, fulfill the duty to appear in court in response to litigation in accordance with the law, and cooperate with the people's courts in conducting court hearings. On June 27, 2016, the General Office of the State Council formally issued the Opinions in the form of Document Guo Ban Fa [2016] No. 54. The issuance of the Opinions is of great significance for the people's courts to further improve the acceptance, hearing, and enforcement of administrative cases, fully exercise the function of administrative adjudication, effectively supervise administrative organs in exercising their powers in accordance with the law, and enhance the ability of leading cadres to study and apply the law. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law, and to further standardize and promote administrative litigation response, notice is hereby given on the following issues:

1. Fully Recognize the Great Significance of Standardizing Administrative Litigation Response

Promoting responsible persons of administrative organs to appear in court in response to litigation is an important measure to implement the revised Administrative Procedure Law; standardizing administrative litigation response is an important measure to ensure the effective implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law, comprehensively advance law-based administration, and accelerate the construction of a law-based government. To implement the requirement set forth in the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Comprehensively Advancing the Rule of Law regarding "improving the system for administrative organs to appear in court in response to litigation in accordance with the law, support the courts in accepting administrative cases, and respect and enforce effective judgments and rulings of the courts," the Opinions, from ten aspects including "attach high importance to administrative litigation response work," "support the people's courts in accepting and hearing administrative cases in accordance with the law," "conscientiously perform the work of submitting pleadings and evidence," "fulfill the duty to appear in court in response to litigation in accordance with the law," and "actively implement effective judgments and rulings of the people's courts," sets forth clear requirements and makes specific arrangements for strengthening and improving administrative litigation response. The Opinions is the first specialized document in China to comprehensively regulate administrative litigation response work. People's courts at all levels shall, in conjunction with the spirit of the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law, fully grasp the content of the Opinions, deeply understand its essence, fully recognize the great significance of the issuance of the Opinions, and ensure that the Opinions take root in the field of administrative adjudication of the people's courts. They shall promptly report to the local Party committee and people's congress on the implementation of the Opinions, strengthen communication and liaison with the government, support local Party committees and governments in issuing specific implementation measures for their respective regions, refine and improve relevant work systems, and promote administrative organs to do a good job in appearing in court in response to litigation.

2. Handle the Acceptance and Hearing of Administrative Cases in Accordance with the Law

Strictly implement the Administrative Procedure Law and the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Registration and Filing of Cases by the People's Courts, further strengthen the protection of the right of action in administrative litigation, and shall not illegally narrow the scope of case acceptance or illegally add conditions for filing a lawsuit. It is strictly prohibited to delay or refuse to file a case by repeatedly requiring the plaintiff to supplement the materials for filing a lawsuit. For cases where the complaint is not accepted, or where a written voucher is not issued after accepting the complaint, or where the content of the complaint needing supplementation is not fully informed to the party at one time, the directly responsible supervisors and other directly responsible persons shall be subject to disciplinary and disciplinary sanctions in accordance with the relevant provisions, such as the Measures for the Investigation of Liability for Illegal Adjudication by Judicial Personnel of the People's Courts (Trial Implementation) and the Regulations on the Punishment of Personnel of the People's Courts. Resolutely resist various illegal acts that interfere with or obstruct the people's courts from accepting and hearing administrative cases in accordance with the law. If leading cadres or administrative organs, in any form such as holding coordination meetings, issuing documents, or making oral requests, explicitly or implicitly indicate that the people's courts shall not accept a case, shall not render a judgment against the administrative organ, or shall not enforce an effective judgment or ruling of the people's courts, the Provisions on the Recording, Notification, and Accountability for Leading Cadres Interfering with Judicial Activities and Intervening in the Handling of Specific Cases and the Provisions on the Recording and Accountability for Internal Personnel of Judicial Organs Inquiring About Cases shall be strictly implemented, and comprehensive and truthful records shall be made, ensuring a complete trail with evidence for verification.

3. Promote Responsible Persons of Administrative Organs to Appear in Court in Response to Litigation in Accordance with the Law

Accurately understand the relevant provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law and related judicial interpretations, correctly grasp the basic requirements for responsible persons of administrative organs to appear in court in response to litigation, and promote the work of responsible persons of administrative organs appearing in court in response to litigation in accordance with the law. First, the responsible persons of administrative organs who appear in court in response to litigation include both the principal responsible persons and the deputy responsible persons, as well as other responsible persons who share in the division of responsibilities. Second, if the responsible person of an administrative organ cannot appear in court, the administrative organ shall entrust its corresponding staff to appear in court, and shall not entrust only a lawyer to appear in court. Third, in cases involving major public interests, high social concern, or those that may cause mass incidents, as well as cases where the people's court has issued a written suggestion for the responsible person of the administrative organ to appear in court, the responsible person of the sued administrative organ shall appear in court. Fourth, the term "corresponding staff of the administrative organ" as used in Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Administrative Procedure Law includes staff of the administrative organ who hold state administrative establishment status, as well as other persons who perform public duties in accordance with the law. If the sued administrative act was made by the people's government, staff of the legal affairs working body under the people's government and staff of the specific organ undertaking the sued administrative act may also be regarded as the corresponding staff of the sued people's government.

If neither the responsible person of the administrative organ nor the corresponding staff of the administrative organ appears in court and only a lawyer is entrusted to appear, or if the people's court has issued a written suggestion for the responsible person of the administrative organ to appear in court but the responsible person does not appear, the people's court shall record the matter in the case file and state it in the judgment document, may issue a public announcement in accordance with Article 66, Paragraph 2 of the Administrative Procedure Law, and suggest that the appointing and removal organ, the supervisory organ, or the administrative organ at the next higher level impose severe sanctions on the responsible persons concerned.

4. Provide Necessary Conditions for Administrative Organs to Fulfill Their Duty to Appear in Court in Response to Litigation in Accordance with the Law

While adhering to the independent and impartial exercise of adjudicative power in accordance with the law and equally protecting the litigation rights of all parties, people's courts at all levels shall strengthen contact with government legal affairs departments and administrative law enforcement organs, explore the establishment of a liaison mechanism for administrative adjudication and administrative litigation response, promptly communicate and coordinate specific matters such as the issuance of suggestions for responsible persons of administrative organs to appear in court and the timing of court hearings, and effectively implement the spirit of the Administrative Procedure Law and the Opinions, steadily advancing the work of administrative organs appearing in court in response to litigation. They shall provide necessary guarantees and appropriate conveniences for responsible persons of administrative organs, staff, government legal advisors, and public lawyers to fulfill their duty to appear in court in response to litigation in accordance with the law. The principle of legality review of administrative acts shall be correctly understood. If the administrative reconsideration organ and the administrative organ that made the original administrative act are co-defendants, they may, based on the specific circumstances, determine that one organ shall perform the burden of proof to ensure the focus of the court hearing and improve its efficiency. Reform the case hearing model, promote the separation of simple and complex cases, achieve speedy trial of simple cases and careful trial of complex cases, and alleviate the litigation burden on the parties. For cases that meet the conditions set forth in Article 3, Paragraph 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, if the people's court deems that a court hearing is unnecessary, it may directly rule to dismiss the lawsuit. Promptly issue judicial suggestions regarding issues and deficiencies in the work of administrative organs appearing in court in response to litigation and administrative law enforcement, and promptly notify the government legal affairs department of the implementation and feedback of judicial suggestions, so as to prevent and resolve disputes at the source. Actively participate in education and training on administrative litigation response to improve the administrative litigation response capabilities of responsible persons of administrative organs, administrative law enforcement personnel, and other relevant persons.

5. Support Administrative Organs in Establishing and Improving the Assessment System for Law-Based Administration

People's courts shall support local Party committees and governments in establishing and improving the assessment system for law-based administration, and put forward opinions and suggestions for strengthening and improving administrative litigation response in light of the actual work of administrative adjudication. With regard to the implementation of the work of administrative organs appearing in court in response to litigation and the assessment indicators for law-based administration in the local area, as well as their operational effectiveness, the people's courts may, through appropriate forms such as judicial suggestions and white papers, promptly provide feedback and evaluation to the administrative organs, and may, by appropriate means, publicly disclose to the public the situation of administrative organs appearing in court in response to litigation in the local area, thereby promoting the forcing effect of the assessment indicators.

Local people's courts at all levels shall promptly summarize the good experiences and practices formed during the implementation of this Notice; any difficulties and problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

July 28, 2016
